description: Event Merge 2: joins two polyphonic note bundles into one, placing the second bundle's voices after the first instead of adding their voltages together

inputs.text: The pitch of the A bundle, one channel to a voice
The gate of the A bundle
The trigger of the A bundle
The velocity of the A bundle
The accent of the A bundle
The pitch of the B bundle, one channel to a voice
The gate of the B bundle
The trigger of the B bundle
The velocity of the B bundle
The accent of the B bundle

outputs.text: The pitches of both bundles, the A voices first
The gates of both bundles, the A voices first
The triggers of both bundles, the A voices first
The velocities of both bundles, the A voices first
The accents of both bundles, the A voices first

notes: each bundle is as many voices as the widest of its five jacks, and the merged bundle stops at sixteen
